title: Recursive majority step
statement: For natural numbers $n,d$ and a sign vector $x$ with $n^{d+1}$ coordinates, the recursive majority of depth $d+1$ is the majority of the $n$ recursive-majority outputs obtained from the $n$ consecutive blocks of $n^d$ coordinates of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector with $n^{d+1}$ coordinates
